summary: This note is a short biography of Doug Smail, a hockey player who competed for the University of North Dakota from 1977 to 1980. It notes his scoring in his final collegiate season and his subsequent move to the NHL with the Winnipeg Jets.
one_line: Doug Smail was a University of North Dakota hockey player from 1977 to 1980 who went on to play full-time in the NHL with the Winnipeg Jets.
key_facts: Doug Smail starred at the University of North Dakota for three seasons.
Doug Smail's University of North Dakota tenure ran from 1977 to 1980.
Doug Smail scored 87 points in 40 games in his final season in the WCHA.
Doug Smail's final collegiate season was played in the WCHA.
Doug Smail's performance drew notice from the Winnipeg Jets.
Doug Smail became a full-time NHL player the season after his college career ended.
Doug Smail's NHL career began with the Winnipeg Jets.
